observations:
All bechina-connected concept families in Torah #64 fall within three identifiable packages derived from the connected components of the bechina graph. No cluster of 3+ concepts was found that forms an independent bechina domain not already captured by those three packages.

The four candidate domains examined:

(1) EMUNAH / FAITH CLUSTER: The Torah discusses emunah extensively — as the vehicle for transcending the chalal ha-panui, as having its own niggun, as 'rosh emunah' (supreme faith). However, in the bechina dataset for Torah #64, emunah appears only in eitza edges (it 'causes' the passing over of heresies) and not in bechina edges. The gap additions (tzaddik ha-dor, rosh emunah, kevad peh) all connect to the SHITIKA cluster (Package 2) rather than forming their own independent domain. The emunah-niggun-rosh-emunah chain is the positive expression of Package 2's shitika/Moses cluster, not a distinct new package. Adding the gap nodes would simply enrich Package 2.

(2) APIKORSUT / HERESY CLUSTER: The Torah defines two types of apikorsut at length — from external wisdoms (klipot/shevirat kelim) and from the chalal ha-panui (unanswerable). However, neither is given its own bechina identity independent of the existing packages. The first type belongs to Package 3 (klipot/shchok) and the second is simply a property of Package 1 (chalal ha-panui). No 3+ node independent bechina family for apikorsut is detectable.

(3) CREATION-BY-SPEECH CLUSTER: The Torah develops the idea that creation occurred through speech (dibur), that Torah scholars create worlds through their speech, and that each type of wisdom has its own melody. The concepts dibur, chokhmah, and yemim u-midot appear. However, in the bechina dataset for Torah #64, none of these appear as bechina nodes — the Torah's discussion of creation-through-speech functions as the theoretical framework (context) and is expressed through eitza relationships, not bechina equivalences. The single bechina edge 'machloket — briat ha-olam' was merged into Package 1. No independent creation-through-speech package forms.

(4) NIGGUN / MELODY CLUSTER: The Torah contains an extended discussion of melody — every wisdom has its unique niggun, the niggun of heresy caused Acher to sin (zimra yevanit), the supreme niggun of emunah belongs to the Moses-level tzaddik. The pair neginah–ruach IS in the dataset (edge 2681) and has been merged into Package 2. The broader melody-domain (zimra yevanit, kol niggun le-fi bechinat chokhmato, le'atid Moses will sing again) does not produce additional bechina edges in the dataset beyond that one pair. The melody-of-heresy (zimra yevanit) belongs to Package 3 as an aspect of the kelipot-domain, but does not appear as a bechina node in the dataset. Insufficient bechina data to constitute a new package.

Conclusion: The three packages identified — (1) חָלָל הַפָּנוּי וְהַצִּמְצוּם, (2) שְׁתִיקָה וּמֹשֶׁה, (3) שְׂחוֹק וּקְלִפּוֹת — fully account for all bechina-connected nodes in the dataset for Torah #64. The gap additions flagged in torah_64_additions.json would, if added to the dataset, enrich Package 2 (by 3 nodes: tzaddik ha-dor, kevad peh, rosh emunah) and Package 1 (by 1 node: ivriim), but would not create any new independent package domain.
